name: Path Builder
description: Records your editor playtest path and auto-places blocks and spikes around it.

style.name: Placement Style
style.description:
<cy>basic</c>: floor/ceiling blocks + a few spikes under each jump.
<cy>dense</c>: fill every safe spot with spikes and use tighter corridors.
<cy>blocks-only</c>: no spikes at all.
<cy>tight</c>: spikes (and saws) placed off-grid right against your real hitbox for every gamemode, cube included. Your own blocks are kept clear. Gap and spacing are set in pixels below.

mode-cube.name: Cube (and Robot)
mode-cube.description: Generate platforms and jump spikes for cube/robot parts.

mode-ship.name: Ship (and Swing)
mode-ship.description: Generate a corridor around ship/swing parts.

mode-wave.name: Wave
mode-wave.description: Generate a corridor around wave parts.

mode-ball.name: Ball (and Spider)
mode-ball.description: Generate floor/ceiling blocks and spikes for ball/spider parts.

mode-ufo.name: UFO
mode-ufo.description: Generate a corridor around UFO parts.

max-spikes.name: Spikes per Jump (basic)
max-spikes.description: Max spikes placed under one jump in basic style.

clearance-blocks.name: Spike Clearance (blocks)
clearance-blocks.description: Safe gap between your hitbox and spike hitboxes for basic/dense, in grid blocks (1 = 1 block).

tight-gap.name: Tight Gap (px)
tight-gap.description: Tight style only. Gap between your hitbox and each spike hitbox in free-move pixels (30 px = 1 block). 0 = touching, 1 = one pixel.

portal-gap.name: Portal Gap (px)
portal-gap.description: Tight style only. Gap used instead of Tight Gap right around portals, speed portals, pads, gravity and size changes, where GD's timing inside a physics step can differ slightly. Elsewhere Tight Gap is used. If this is smaller than Tight Gap, Tight Gap is used everywhere.

tight-spacing.name: Tight Spike Spacing (px)
tight-spacing.description: Tight style only. Horizontal distance between spikes in free-move pixels (30 px = 1 block). Lower = more spikes.

saw-chance.name: Saw Chance (%)
saw-chance.description: Tight style only. Share of spots that get a saw instead of a spike, mixed in between the spikes. 0 = spikes only.

saw-ids.name: Saw Object IDs
saw-ids.description: Saws to pick from at random, comma separated. Their round hitbox is read from the game.

size-min.name: Min Size
size-min.description: Tight style only. Smallest random scale for spikes and saws (1 = normal).

size-max.name: Max Size
size-max.description: Tight style only. Largest random scale for spikes and saws (1 = normal). Set both to 1 for normal sizes.

ship-margin-blocks.name: Ship/UFO Corridor Margin (blocks)
ship-margin-blocks.description: Free space above and below the ship/UFO path, in grid blocks (1 = 1 block).

wave-margin-blocks.name: Wave Corridor Margin (blocks)
wave-margin-blocks.description: Free space above and below the wave path, in grid blocks (1 = 1 block).

block-id.name: Block Object ID
block-id.description: Object ID used for blocks (1 = default block).

spike-id.name: Spike Object ID
spike-id.description: Object ID used for spikes (8 = default spike).

select-generated.name: Select Generated Objects
select-generated.description: Select everything that was placed so you can move or delete it in one go.

show-messages.name: Show Messages
show-messages.description: Show info messages at the bottom of the editor (path recorded, objects placed, bot on/off). Warnings always show.

play-bot.name: Showcase Bot (real play)
play-bot.description:
Replay the clicks saved in the editor when you play the level for real, for showcase videos.
<cr>Safe mode is forced while this is on</c>: progress stays at 0%, completions, stars, attempts and jumps are not saved, and the level can't be verified.

check-speed.name: Check / SIM Speed
check-speed.description: How many frames CHK and SIM run per real frame (up to 100x). Each frame is played at the frame rate your clicks were recorded at, so results don't depend on the speed. Very high values can make the phone lag or get warm.
